name: viridis-regulatory-radar
description: Screen US, California, EU and global climate and energy regulations with source-linked deadlines.

interface.longDescription: Regulatory Radar answers "what climate and energy rules apply to us, and when?" from a curated, source-linked dataset. Scan a jurisdiction (US, California, EU, Canada and more), optionally filtered by sector, to get applicable regulations with effective dates, reporting deadlines, urgency flags and legal status (binding, voluntary framework, stayed or enjoined), each with a source URL and the date it was last verified. Watch for requirements becoming effective or deadlines approaching in a 1-365 day window. Screen a company's disclosure posture: only binding obligations count, size-gated rules such as California SB 253 ask for annual revenue before they are applied, and stayed, enjoined or voluntary items are listed separately for context. Build an evidence pack that retrieves the official regulator pages live and records a timestamp and SHA-256 hash for each. Results are deterministic screening, not legal advice; every record cites its authority.
capabilities: Scan climate and energy regulations by jurisdiction and sector
Flag reporting deadlines and legal status with source links
Watch for deadlines and effective dates in a time window
Screen a company's binding disclosure obligations
Build a source-hashed evidence pack from official regulator pages
defaultPrompt: Which climate disclosure deadlines apply in California in the next 90 days?
Screen EU sustainability reporting rules for a manufacturer.
What is the SB 253 first reporting deadline and who must file?

positive.description: California scan lists binding and non-binding rules with sources
positive.prompt: Use Viridis Regulatory Radar to scan regulations for California and list anything urgent.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns about 7 regulations for california (plus US and global). California SB 253 appears as binding with a 2026-11-10 first reporting deadline; every record has a source_url and source_verified_on date; the SEC rule is labelled stayed and SB 261 enforcement enjoined.

positive.description: Deadline watch over a time window
positive.prompt: What California climate reporting deadlines are coming up in the next 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns deadline_approaching changes in the 30-day window (SB 253 while its deadline is within the window) with days until the deadline, legal status and the CARB source link.

positive.description: Company screen with revenue applies the SB 253 size gate
positive.prompt: Assess climate disclosure compliance for an energy company in California with $2 billion annual revenue and no disclosures yet.
positive.expected_behavior: SB 253 is the binding gap with its deadline and remediation steps; voluntary frameworks, the stayed SEC rule and enjoined SB 261 are listed under not_currently_binding, not as gaps.

positive.description: Company screen without revenue stays undetermined
positive.prompt: Assess climate disclosure compliance for an energy company in California.
positive.expected_behavior: overall_compliance_level is undetermined (never compliant) and SB 253 is listed under applicability_unconfirmed, asking for annual revenue because it binds only at $1 billion or more.

positive.prompt: Build a regulatory evidence pack for California.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieves the official CARB and SEC pages live (about 4 sources), each with retrieved_at, http_status 200 and a SHA-256 hash, plus a curated deadline calendar and a screening-only notice.

negative.description: Not a legal-advice or filing service
negative.prompt: File my company's SB 253 emissions report with CARB for me.
Write me a poem about autumn leaves.
Scan the climate regulations for the planet Mars.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, payments, subscriptions or upgrade offers inside ChatGPT. This plugin connects to a commerce-free endpoint (/chatgpt/regulatory-radar/mcp) that removes all pricing and payment content; when the free daily limit is reached it returns a neutral 'resets at 00:00 UTC' message.

publication.release_notes: First release: five read/screen tools over a curated, source-linked climate regulation dataset, a revenue-gated compliance screen and a live, hashed evidence pack.
